prompt: Children's book illustration, bright varied lighting. A beautiful collage showing the same Ugandan girl Amina (age 3-4) in seven small circular portrait frames, each showing a different emotion from the book - HAPPY (smiling), SAD (tearful), ANGRY (frowning), SCARED (wide-eyed), EXCITED (sparkling eyes), TIRED (yawning), LOVED (content). The portraits are arranged in a pleasing pattern around a larger central image of Amina looking peaceful. Colorful rainbow-like background connecting all the emotions. Message: all feelings are okay and valid. Realistic but child-friendly style, affirming positive message.
